summary.zh: 让守卫走向你制造的声响，空出真正想走的路。
summary.en: Send a guard toward a sound to open the route you actually want.

rules.zh: 投掷物或技能在某个位置发出声音，听见的守卫会调查声源并暂时改变巡逻。玩家利用这段空当通过、取物或伏击；声音范围、响应对象和调查结束时机需要可读。
rules.en: A thrown object or ability creates a sound that draws nearby guards off patrol. Use the opening to pass, collect something or ambush; make hearing range, responders and investigation duration readable.

decisions.zh: 把守卫引得很远更安全，但会不会同时惊动第二个人？
decisions.en: A distant lure may be safer, but will it attract a second guard?

decisions.zh: 现在取回可重复使用的诱饵，还是先利用短暂的通路？
decisions.en: Recover the reusable lure now, or use the brief open route first?

effect.zh: 范围越大越好命中目标，也越难只引开一个人。
effect.en: A wider radius reaches targets easily but makes selective distraction harder.

effect.zh: 停留时间决定玩家能完成多长的动作链，过长会抹掉紧迫感。
effect.en: Duration sets the length of the available action sequence; excessive time removes urgency.

contrast.zh: 硬币把声源放在远处；口哨把声源绑在角色身上，要求先准备好撤退或接敌位置。
contrast.en: Coins place sound elsewhere; a whistle anchors it to the character, requiring an escape or ambush position.

combination.zh: 设计提案：借用落点选择，让石子在金属、泥土和水面上产生不同声响，玩家先读地面再投掷。
combination.en: Design proposal: borrow cast-placement decisions; stones make different sounds on metal, mud and water, so players read surfaces before throwing.

setup.zh: 门前有一名守卫，门右侧有一个空房间。
setup.en: A guard watches the door; an empty room sits to the right.

action.zh: 你把石子扔进空房，自己留在门左侧。
action.en: Throw a pebble into the empty room while staying left of the door.

result.zh: 守卫转身调查，门口暂时无人注视。
result.en: The guard turns to investigate, briefly leaving the doorway unwatched.

next.zh: 你穿过门，决定是否还要冒险回收石子。
next.en: Pass through and decide whether recovering the pebble is worth the risk.

firstStep.zh: 做一个巡逻守卫、一个可投掷石子，以及巡逻—调查—返回三个状态。
firstStep.en: Build one patrolling guard, one throwable pebble and patrol–investigate–return states.

pitfall.zh: 别让守卫无提示地随机无视声响；先固定谁响应、响应多久。
pitfall.en: Avoid unexplained random refusal to investigate; first make responder selection and duration consistent.

test.zh: 玩家能否在投掷前指出哪名守卫会移动，并利用空当完成一次通过？
test.en: Can players predict which guard will move and use the opening to get past?
